newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel slips on NYMEX, Gulf activity quickens.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel slips on NYMEX, Gulf activity quickens.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices edged lower Friday tracking December futures and stable differentials, with activity quickened in the Gulf by today's scheduling deadline for back-32nd cycle fuel shipments on the Colonial Pipeline.

"It's not a runaway market but at least a few deals are getting done thanks to the scheduling deadline," one Gulf player said, as offers for aviation-quality 54-grade fuel held to about even with the December print.
New York Harbor 54-grade sold for 2.65 cents over the screen, stable with Thursday diffs, players said.
